Dr. Rhonda Patrick joins Joe Rogan for episode 459 of the Joe Rogan Experience, an early visit in the show's run. Patrick is a scientist who studies how food, heat, and genes shape health. Her talks made her a star of the health podcast world.

Patrick walks Rogan through the science of food, from greens to fats, in plain terms. She shares what tests show on heat, cold, and the brain. The talk has the fresh feel of the show's young years. Listeners get a dense but clear health class. The library keeps the episode as a record of her early visit.
